abstract: A case of a benign, cystic intrapulmonary teratoma occurring in the left lobe of a 63-yr-old female is described and the typical clinical symptoms and distinguishing X-ray appearances which may be helpful in diagnosing this rare tumour are mentioned. The connection between the tumor and the segmental bronchus clearly established the true intrapulmonary nature of the lesion in this case and the unusual finding of thymic tissue within the wall supports previous speculation regarding the possible thymic origin of these neoplasms.
abstract_ja: 63歳女性の左肺葉に生じた良性の嚢胞性肺内奇形腫の症例を記載する。本疾患に特徴的な臨床症状および画像所見を述べ、診断の助けとなる点を示す。腫瘍と区域気管支の連続性により、病変が真の肺内由来であることが確認された。壁内に胸腺組織を認めたことは、これら腫瘍の胸腺起源説を支持する。
